title: cnti-testsuite.yaml
description: The configuration that tells the CNTi Test Suite how to install a CNF (cnf_install) and how some tests treat it. Version v2. Described in docs/CNTI_TESTSUITE_YAML_USAGE.md; check a file with `cnti-testsuite validate_config --cnf-config PATH`. Values may use {{ ENV.NAME }} placeholders, rendered before parsing.

config_version.description: The format version. v1 files are converted on the fly; `update_config` writes them as v2.

container_names.description: Per container: the released image tags the rolling update, downgrade and version change tests move to, and the tag rollback starts from. A container without the tag a test needs is left out of that test.

white_list_container_names.description: Containers the privileged_containers test leaves out.

workload_resource_labels.description: Labels that pick the CNF's workloads when its deployments don't name them directly.

docker_insecure_registries.description: Registries the suite reaches without TLS verification.

image_registry_fqdns.description: Registry name to fully qualified host, for images given without one.

hardcoded_ip_exceptions.description: IP addresses the hardcoded IP test accepts in the CNF's runtime configuration.

tls_profiles.description: Named TLS settings, used by a Helm deployment's tls_profile.

image_size_max_mb.description: The reasonable_image_size limit in megabytes, instead of the default.

startup_time_max_seconds.description: The reasonable_startup_time limit in seconds, instead of the default 30.

name.description: Container name, as in the pod spec.

rolling_update_test_tag.description: A newer released tag for rolling_update.

rolling_downgrade_test_tag.description: An older released tag for rolling_downgrade.

rolling_version_change_test_tag.description: A different released tag for rolling_version_change.

rollback_from_tag.description: A released tag, other than the installed one, that rollback rolls out and then undoes.

auth_defaults.description: Credentials by registry host or Helm repository name, used when a chart doesn't carry its own auth.

auth.description: A token, or a username and password. Keep secrets out of the file: use {{ ENV.NAME }} placeholders.

deployments.description: What cnf_install installs. At least one deployment, and every name unique across the three lists.

helm_charts.description: Charts from a Helm repository (helm_repo_name, helm_repo_url, helm_chart_name) or an OCI registry (registry_url, chart_version).

helm_dirs.description: Chart directories, relative to this file.

manifests.description: Directories of Kubernetes manifests, relative to this file.

latency_sensitive.description: A workload, and the containers in it, that needs exclusive CPUs (checked by exclusive_cpus).

name.description: The deployment's name, unique in the file; also the Helm release name.

priority.description: Install order: lower first, higher removed first.

helm_values.description: Extra helm arguments, such as `--set key=value` or `--values file.yaml`.

namespace.description: Namespace to install into; cnti-default when empty.

helm_repo_name.description: Classic repository: the alias it is added under.

helm_chart_name.description: Classic repository: the chart's name. Ignored for OCI, where it comes from registry_url.

registry_url.description: OCI chart: oci://host/path/chart. Needs chart_version, and excludes the helm_repo_* fields.

plain_http.description: OCI chart: reach the registry over HTTP.

chart_version.description: Chart version: required for OCI, optional for a classic repository.

auth.description: Credentials for this chart, instead of common.auth_defaults.

name.description: The deployment's name, unique in the file; also the Helm release name.

priority.description: Install order: lower first, higher removed first.

helm_values.description: Extra helm arguments, such as `--set key=value` or `--values file.yaml`.

namespace.description: Namespace to install into; cnti-default when empty.

helm_directory.description: The chart's directory, relative to this file.

name.description: The deployment's name, unique in the file.

priority.description: Install order: lower first, higher removed first.

manifest_directory.description: The manifests' directory, relative to this file.
